core.title: Heavy Duty 8 Inch Hands Free Door Stop, Imperial USA GH-6015
tags: Heavy Duty 8 Inch Hands Free Door Stops

text.description_html:
Imperial USA, 8″ Step On Door Holder

A great solution for commercial doors, this hands free step on door holder mounts to the bottom of the door. Pushing the plunger down with your foot using the extra big foot pad holds the door open. Then, simply toe the spring loaded release tab to deactivate the door stop. The Heavy Duty 8 Inch Hands Free Door Stop is easy to install. It comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware. This Heavy Duty Plunger Door Holder includes a non-skid rubber tip to protect the floor.

Also available: Satin Brass 8 Inch Hands Free Door Stop & Replacement Rubber Tip.

Specifications and Features of the Heavy Duty Plunger Door Holder:

  • Material: Brass
  • Overall Length: 8"
  • Housing Body Length: 7"
  • Housing Body Width (at widest part): 1-1/2"
  • Housing Body Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Rubber Stop Length: 1"
  • Maximum Bolt Projection: 2"
  • Foot Pad: 1" x 1-1/2"
  • Rubber Color: Black
  • Polybagged with sheet metal screws.

Sold individually.
